title: MACP Policy Descriptor
description: Validates a PolicyDescriptor document in JSON form. See RFC-MACP-0012.

mode.description: Mode identifier this policy applies to, or '*' for mode-agnostic.

schema_version.description: Version of the rule schema used (1, 2, or 3). Version 2 adds the Decision Mode decline-gating parameters; that bump is additive and version 1 policies remain valid. Version 3 is SEMANTIC, not additive: it changes the empty-tally rule so voting algorithms other than 'none' fail when no decisive vote (for 'weighted', no decisive weight) has been cast. Versions 1-2 retain the legacy require_vote_quorum-gated rule so stored sessions replay identically. See RFC-MACP-0012 Sections 4.1 and 8.

rules.description: Mode-specific governance rules. In protobuf, this is a JSON string field.

registered_at_unix_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when registered. Set by runtime.
